info.title: StuHelper Favorites
info.description: Own favorite receipts and folders. New favorites require current content admission; own reads, moves and removals require login only. Each owner may keep up to 200 folders and 10000 favorite items. Titles are snapshots and do not grant access to public detail. Default folder has an empty name until renamed by its owner; clients localize the default label. POST requests require Content-Type application/json. Missing or unsupported media types return 400.

get.description: Export the signed-in owner’s folders and favorite items. Each page returns at most limit folders and limit items. Follow next until it is absent to include every matching item and all folders, including empty folders.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of folders and maximum number of items per page.

item_count.description: Current number of own favorites in this folder, without kind or text filters.

KindCounts.description: Per-kind breakdown of own favorites in this folder, unaffected by list filters.

reason.description: Machine-readable sub-reason for precise eight-language UI and accessibility error mapping.

name.description: Trim leading and trailing Unicode whitespace. Names must be unique within the owner folders (case-sensitive), including a renamed default folder.

Trim leading and trailing Unicode whitespace. Custom folders require 1 to 20 Unicode code points; passing an empty name on the default folder resets it to the unnamed state so clients render the localized default label. Non-empty names must be unique within the owner folders (case-sensitive).
